segments.description: Leases its Parkersburg, West Virginia office building and provides advisory, accounting and management services to an independent oil and gas company.
segments.evidence: The Company's operations during 2025 include both leasing its office building located in Parkersburg West Virginia and managing the oil and gas operations it sold in August 2020 to a third party.
